about:
J.H. Larson Company, headquartered in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, traces its origins to 1949. The company's founding details, including the names of its founders and ownership structure, are not publicly disclosed in the available sources.

The firm operates as a broad-line distributor of electrical, industrial, and construction supplies. Its catalog spans categories such as conduit and fittings, wire and cable, lighting fixtures, hand tools, fasteners, and safety equipment. In addition to product distribution, Larson provides jobsite solutions, project management support, digital procurement tools, and specialty services. The company maintains showrooms and multiple locations, though specific facility sizes and employee counts are not published.

Larson serves electrical contractors, industrial maintenance teams, commercial builders, and institutional facilities across the Upper Midwest and beyond. Its supplier roster includes manufacturers such as 3M, Arlington Industries, Ideal Industries, Hubbell, and Southwire, among hundreds of others. The product range addresses applications in power distribution, lighting, data communications, HVAC, and plumbing.

The company emphasizes service-oriented capabilities—jobsite delivery, project coordination, and digital ordering—as core to its value proposition. No specific founding mission or stated differentiation beyond service breadth is documented in the provided sources.
